settings.heading: Get each week's challenge by email
settings.intro: One email when a new challenge is published — at most one a week, usually Thursday. Nothing else is sent to this list.
settings.note: Separate from the guides list: signing up here adds you only to the Weekly Website Fix reminders. At most one email a week, sent when a challenge goes live; if a week is skipped, no email. Unsubscribe from any email. See the privacy policy.
settings.success_body: The next challenge will arrive by email when it is published. Until then, the schedule above has the dates and every published challenge is in the archive.
